observations:
Five screenshots (1.PNG - 5.PNG, 1366 px wide, 586-593 px high), each showing a different report selected: 1 = Daily Journal, 2 = Time Clock Report, 3 = Missing Progress Notes, 4 = Appointment Detail by User, 5 = Production Report. Every listed report therefore has exactly one screenshot; there are no popups, expanded dropdowns, scrolled second views or non-report screens in this category. 4.PNG is cropped about 7 px at the top (title bar partly cut, still legible), 3.PNG and 5.PNG by 1-2 px; no content is lost.

SCREEN: dark title bar with 'My Reports' at the left and 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon at the far right. Below it a blue header bar reading 'SELECT REPORT' over the left panel and 'REPORT CRITERIA' over the right panel, with the grey CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at its right end. A small splitter / collapse handle (three vertical dots) sits between the two panels at mid height. A light action bar at the bottom of the criteria panel holds two blue right-aligned buttons: PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon). No footer text and no scrollbars anywhere. 'My Reports' is an entry of the top-level Reports menu (drop_down_options.PNG in the parent folder), which also lists 'My Favorites' and 'Search Report'.

REPORT LIST: exactly 5 radio items in a two-column bordered grid - left column Daily Journal, Time Clock Report, Missing Progress Notes; right column Appointment Detail by User, Production Report (the third cell of the right column is empty). The rest of the left panel is uniform empty dark blue (pixel-verified), so the list is not scrollable or clipped.

RECURRING PATTERNS: every report has PRINT FORMAT (PDF default / Excel) and OFFICE/GROUP (Office default / Office Group, plus an unlabelled read-only box preset to 108 = the OID in the title bar, with a SELECT button). PRINT FORMAT is the right half of the first row for Daily Journal and Time Clock Report (beside REPORT BY / REPORT FORMAT) and a full-width first section for the other three. All Start Date / End Date fields show 11/21/2026 and carry a calendar icon; the screenshot files are dated 2026-11-21, so both ends evidently default to the current date. SELECT buttons carry a building icon for Office and Codes and a person icon for Provider and Operatory; the Provider, Operatory and Codes boxes default to ALL. No report in this category shows a User picker, GROUP BY, SORT BY or Page Break control.

STATE CHECKS (pixel-verified): enabled editable inputs (the REPORT BY dropdown, the date fields) have fill RGB 241,241,241 and border 206,209,219; the read-only picker boxes, the empty CORRESPONDING PROVIDER box and the Fee Schedule dropdown share fill 220,223,226 and border 209,209,209. The only control with paled text is the 'Group By Office' checkbox of Time Clock Report (label 161,161,161, grey box). The Fee Schedule dropdown of Production Report is recorded as disabled on the strength of its read-only box styling although its text is not paled. Every selected radio and ticked checkbox was confirmed by its blue fill, every unselected one by its empty dark ring / box. A scan of each criteria panel for box borders and for dark or grey ink, and of all blank areas, found no further control or text (no Page Break checkboxes, no right-edge items, nothing below the last section).

FONT CAVEAT: in the bold section-header font the capital G is drawn almost exactly like C at this size, so the pixels look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANCE' and 'CORRESPONDINC PROVIDER'; they are transcribed as OFFICE/GROUP, DATE RANGE, APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE and CORRESPONDING PROVIDER (the mixed-case labels 'Office Group' and 'General' show a clear G, and the other category inventories read the same headers this way).

CROSS-REFERENCE (from the sibling category inventories, not from these screenshots): 'Daily Journal' and 'Production Report' also exist in Daily Reports with fuller criteria (Provider / User pickers, REPORT FORMAT, GROUP BY, Page Break ...), and 'Time Clock Report' also exists in Management Reports (there with a USER picker and without a PRINT FORMAT section). The My Reports versions are separate screens with no User picker: Daily Journal has a REPORT BY dropdown showing 'User', Production Report has a display-only CORRESPONDING PROVIDER box, and Time Clock Report has PRINT FORMAT but no user filter. 'Missing Progress Notes' and 'Appointment Detail by User' do not appear under these names in the other category inventories written so far.

UNKNOWNS: the values of the two collapsed dropdowns (REPORT BY other than 'User'; Fee Schedule other than 'CIGNA PPO HAMILTON ( 128 )'), the contents of the SELECT picker dialogs (Office, Office Group, Provider, Operatory, Codes), the tooltip of the Fee Schedule info icon, and what enables 'Group By Office' and the Fee Schedule dropdown are not shown in any screenshot.

supplement_unresolved.question: Values of the REPORT BY dropdown other than User are not documented, and what User selects is unverified (presumably the lines entered by the logged-in user). The other value is presumably Provider (lines of the linked provider) - unverified; the pre-2021 My Reports list had separate user-specific and provider-specific Daily Journal reports.
Is Show Datewise Distribution the same per-day recap as Show Datewise Summary on the Daily Reports Daily Journal? The document equates the two without a My Reports source.

PRINT (Patient ID / Patient Chart#): presumably chooses which identifier fills the first column of the journal (Pat ID/ Chart #). The document infers this from the column header of a Daily Reports Daily Journal sample and marks the assumption that this report prints that same Detail layout as unverified; there is no vendor statement about the option.
Exact PATIENT TYPE rule (General = non-ortho patients only? Ortho = ortho-flagged patients only?) is unverified.

When is Group By Office enabled? Presumably with Office Group (unverified). The vendor also states that the office of a punch is not tracked or reported, which conflicts with an office filter and Group By Office.

No vendor description of this report was found. How does the My Reports own-data restriction apply when the screen shows a Provider picker defaulting to ALL? Does ALL list every appointment with its note status (unverified)?

How is "by User" applied when the screen has no User picker - presumably the User grouping of the parent Appointment Detail report limited to the logged-in user as creator of the appointment (unverified)? How does the restriction interact with the Provider picker?

A vendor screenshot of the parent report (Appointment Reports > Appointment Detail) shows GROUP BY Provider / User, PAGE BREAK BY None / Date / Provider / User, APPOINTMENT TYPE Regular / Archived, Only AppointNow Appointments, Include Patient Home Office and CANCELLATION REASON. The document calls them parent-only, on the strength of our capture alone - are they absent from the My Reports copy in every state?

Which provider does the Provider picker filter by? The output of the parent Appointment Detail report groups by the appointment provider and prints the preferred provider in a separate column; the document gives no vendor statement for the picker (nor for Operatory).

Does ticking Include UCR unlock the Fee Schedule dropdown here as it does on the Daily Reports Production Report (not stated for this copy)? The tooltip of the info icon beside Fee Schedule and the value list of the dropdown are not documented. The greyed default shown in our capture is presumably tenant data: the document records that the greyed default differs per tenant only for the Fee Schedule To Compare dropdown of the Daily Reports Production Report, not for this copy.
Do the criteria change with PRODUCTION BY = Provider / Category (for example CODES being replaced) as on the Daily Reports copy? Not seen for the My Reports screen.
The picker dialogs behind the Provider and Operatory SELECT buttons are not described; only SEARCH OFFICES and SEARCH CODE are.

The Office / Office Group semantics (Office = offices the user can access, default the logged-in OID; Office Group = groups from Setup > Office Groups, default ALL) and the UPDATE MY FAVORITES relabel are documented from Daily Reports screens and recorded there. Do they apply unchanged to the five My Reports screens (presumably yes)?

Older build: the pre-2021 My Reports list had eight reports - user-specific Daily Journal by User – Detail, Daily Journal by User(created date) – Detail, Appointment Detail by User, Time Clock Report; provider-specific Daily Journal By Provider Detail, Production By Codes, Production By Provider, Production By Category. The current list has five; the old variants are not added as separate reports.
